name: @metorial/help-scout
description: Manage customer support conversations, customers, and knowledge base content. Create, update, assign, and close conversations across shared mailboxes. Add replies, notes, phone and chat logs, and file attachments to conversations, and download files attached to conversation threads. Create and manage customer profiles with contact details. Organize customers into companies/organizations. Browse tags, teams, and users, and run or toggle workflows. Create and update knowledge base articles, collections, and categories via the Docs API. Access support reporting including conversation volume, response times, user productivity, and customer satisfaction ratings.
